news.summary: The return of artificial-intelligence angst pushed Nasdaq futures lower on Tuesday, as South Korean neocloud company Elice Inc.’s debut tanked, spurring concern about the sustainability of the global AI boom. news.title: How CoreWeave’s Debt Binge Brought a Perilous Moment of Reckoning
news.summary: In early 2023, Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman gathered with Jas Khaira, the company’s lead AI investor, and other top executives at the finance giant’s Park Avenue headquarters in Manhattan for a debate: Should they give billions of dollars to a little-known data center developer—CoreWeave—that they had turned down just a few months earlier? CoreWeave had gotten Blackstone to return to the table after landing a multiyear, multibillion-dollar contract to sell cloud computing services to Microsoft. It needed $2.3 billion to buy Nvidia GPUs and secure a data center to house them. In Blackstone’s discussion of the deal, several executives in the room had deep misgivings, according to a person who attended the meeting. CoreWeave was still something of a mystery, a six-year-old, privately held firm that had generated only $16 million in revenue in the previous year. Schwarzman himself was personally worried his investment team could be making a mistake, the person said.
news.title_zh: CoreWeave 的債務狂飆如何帶來危險的清算時刻

news.title: Microsoft Pays Cash For AI. CoreWeave Borrows.

Same AI boom, so why the gap.
news.title_zh: 微軟以現金支付 AI 開支。CoreWeave 則借款。
news.summary_zh: AI 建設部分靠借錢運作，而借錢不便宜：10 年期公債殖利率為 5.1%，通膨回升至 3.7%。兩家 AI 公司展示這對股東意味著什麼。微軟收於 Oct 19，僅比其 52 週高點 Oct 13 低 1.8%。CoreWeave 則比其自身高點 Oct 29, 2025 低 56.3%。同樣的 AI 熱潮，為何會有差距。

news.title: What Is Amazon Stock's Biggest Opportunity?
news.summary: Amazon.com (AMZN) generated $776 billion in sales over its last twelve months, giving the company a scale where most new ventures barely move the total. This size makes it difficult to see what could still lift the stock. Yet management said on its fiscal Q2 2026 call that the cloud business has more demand than it can serve. So what has Amazon already sold that it has not yet delivered.
news.title_zh: Amazon 股票最大的機會是什麼？
news.summary_zh: Amazon.com (AMZN) 過去十二個月產生 $776 billion 營收，使公司規模達到大多數新事業幾乎無法撼動總額的地步。這種規模使人難以看出還有什麼能推高股價。然而管理層在財年 Q2 2026 財報電話會議上表示，雲端業務需求超過其服務能力。那麼 Amazon 已經銷售但尚未交付的是什麼。

news.title: How CoreWeave’s Debt Binge Brought a Perilous Moment of Reckoning
news.summary: In early 2023, Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman gathered with Jas Khaira, the company’s lead AI investor, and other top executives at the finance giant’s Park Avenue headquarters in Manhattan for a debate: Should they give billions of dollars to a little-known data center developer—CoreWeave—that they had turned down just a few months earlier? CoreWeave had gotten Blackstone to return to the table after landing a multiyear, multibillion-dollar contract to sell cloud computing services to Microsoft. It needed $2.3 billion to buy Nvidia GPUs and secure a data center to house them. In Blackstone’s discussion of the deal, several executives in the room had deep misgivings, according to a person who attended the meeting. CoreWeave was still something of a mystery, a six-year-old, privately held firm that had generated only $16 million in revenue in the previous year. Schwarzman himself was personally worried his investment team could be making a mistake, the person said.

items.title: How CoreWeave’s Debt Binge Brought a Perilous Moment of Reckoning
items.summary: In early 2023, Blackstone CEO Steve Schwarzman gathered with Jas Khaira, the company’s lead AI investor, and other top executives at the finance giant’s Park Avenue headquarters in Manhattan for a debate: Should they give billions of dollars to a little-known data center developer—CoreWeave—that they had turned down just a few months earlier? CoreWeave had gotten Blackstone to return to the table after landing a multiyear, multibillion-dollar contract to sell cloud computing services to Microsoft. It needed $2.3 billion to buy Nvidia GPUs and secure a data center to house them. In Blackstone’s discussion of the deal, several executives in the room had deep misgivings, according to a person who attended the meeting. CoreWeave was still something of a mystery, a six-year-old, privately held firm that had generated only $16 million in revenue in the previous year. Schwarzman himself was personally worried his investment team could be making a mistake, the person said.

news.title: What Just Happened To Marvell Stock?
news.summary: Shares of Marvell Technology (MRVL) fell 17.2% over the five trading days from October 9 to October 16, 2026. The broader market saw far less movement during that window, with the S&P 500 losing 1.9%. The stock first slipped the day after its October 6 Investor Day, an event where management actually raised its revenue outlook for fiscal 2028. So how hard was the week for Marvell, and what does its price still appear to assume.
news.title_zh: Marvell 股票剛發生什麼事？
news.summary_zh: Marvell Technology (MRVL) 股價在從 October 9 到 October 16, 2026 的五個交易日內下跌 17.2%。同期大盤波動較小，S&P 500 下跌 1.9%。股價在其 October 6 投資人隔日首次下滑，該活動中管理層實際上調高了財政 2028 年營收展望。那麼這一週對 Marvell 打擊有多大，其股價似乎仍假設了什麼。

news.title: Marvell Jumps 6% as GF Securities Says Google Chip Delay Won’t Dent Its Position; Broadcom Rises 3%
news.summary: A reported delay in Google's next AI chip sent investors scrambling to gauge the fallout for its custom silicon partners, but one analyst thinks the market is misreading what the setback actually means for Marvell's long-term position.
